doc.name: Clay to Claude guide sender
doc.instructions:
Our pay-per-lead pricing has two parts:
1. Setup and infrastructure: $1,000 (at cost)
This covers everything needed to run your campaigns: Enterprise Microsoft (Azure) mailboxes plus Gmail mailboxes giving you up to 50,000 sends per month, email enrichment (purchasing the prospect data), verification of that data so we only send to real valid contacts, and personalisation plus intent/signal data from our providers. All of it billed at cost, no markup.
2. Performance: $300 per qualified meeting attended
You only pay when a genuinely qualified prospect actually shows up to the meeting.
